Wider convex pentagon ABCDE with AB horizontal and the red dashed segment DP labelled 7 with a right-angle mark at P; BC (labelled 4) and AE slope outward. Grey dashed extensions of CB and EA meet below AB at a right angle (marked); the caption reads AB = 16.
